setup.style: Live-action, cinematic neo-noir: rain, neon reflections, warm interiors, a cold blue dawn.

cast.name: Detective Sol

shots.prompt: A wide shot of a narrow alleyway at night in heavy rain, where Detective Sol steps into the slick neon-lit shadows. Detective Sol, a middle-aged Latino man with a shaved head and a thin scar through his right eyebrow, walks into the flooded alley wearing a navy overcoat over a grey shirt and a copper sun badge. He clicks on a heavy flashlight, sweeping a bright white beam through the pouring deluge. Rain streams over his bare scalp and brow as he searches the pavement, his coat shoulders and collar soaking through until the dark wool turns heavy and saturated. The camera holds a wide establishing shot, drifting slowly as Sol moves through the towering wet brick walls.

shots.prompt: A low-angle close-up of a rippling puddle in the rainy night alley, where Detective Sol crouches onto the sodden pavement.
